wizChooseObsidian.message: Save into your local Obsidian vault (needs a plugin installed first)

wizChooseNotion.message: Save into a Notion database in the cloud (free plan works)

wizObInstallIntro.message: This plugin receives the images the extension sends. Three steps:

wizObInstallStep1.message: Click the button below to download the latest plugin zip, then unzip it

wizObInstallStep2.message: Move the unzipped folder into the .obsidian/plugins folder inside your vault (can't find it? In Obsidian: Settings → Community plugins → "Open plugins folder")

wizObInstallStep3.message: Back in Obsidian: Settings → Community plugins, find Media Companion and toggle it on

wizObConnectTitle.message: Step 2: Connect the extension to Obsidian

wizObConnectStep1.message: In Obsidian, open: Settings → Media Companion

wizObConnectStep2.message: Find Local API and toggle it on

wizObConnectStep3.message: Copy the API key shown there and paste it below

wizObTestHint.message: After pasting, click "Test connection" — you can continue once it turns green

wizObFolderHint.message: Clips are saved into this folder in your vault; it's created automatically if missing. Just hit "Finish" if the default is fine.

wizNoTokenIntro.message: Notion requires an "integration" (think of it as a key) before the extension may save anything for you.

wizNoTokenStep1.message: Click the button below to open Notion's integration page (you may need to log in)

wizNoTokenStep2.message: Click "New integration", name it anything, e.g. "Inspiration"

wizNoTokenStep3.message: Copy the Internal Integration Secret it shows and paste it below

wizDoneShortcut.message: Region screenshot: press Alt+Shift+S on any page and drag a box

wizDoneContext.message: Save a full image: right-click any image and choose "Save to library"

wizDonePopup.message: You can also click the extension icon in the toolbar

wizDoneTry.message: Open a normal webpage and give it a go (the browser's own settings pages and the blank new-tab page can't be captured)

ovUsage.message: Usage: press Alt+Shift+S to clip a region, or right-click an image → "Save to library"

errNotionDatabase.message: Can't find the database: make sure it wasn't deleted and its page is still connected to your integration

errNotionSearchEmpty.message: No pages detected yet. Make sure you finished the "Connections" step in Notion, then hit refresh

wizNoConnectTitle.message: Step 2: Duplicate the template and connect it

wizNoConnectIntro.message: Your library is a ready-made template. You duplicate it into your own workspace, so where it lives and what it's called is entirely up to you.

wizNoConnectStep1.message: Click the button below to open the template, hit Duplicate in the top-right, and pick wherever you want it

wizNoConnectStep2.message: Open the copy you just made, click the ⋯ menu in the top-right, choose “Connections”

wizNoConnectStep3.message: Pick the integration you just created from the list

wizNoDetectWaiting.message: Watching… once you connect it, this continues automatically

wizNoDetected.message: Connected to “$1”. Your clips will be saved there

wizNoDetectRetry.message: Nothing happening? Click to check again

errNotionSchema.message: “$1” is missing required columns: $2. Please duplicate the template again and connect that copy
